name: Spicy Grilled Tilapia with Arugula, Crunchy Corn Salsa, Yogurt & Feta

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 green bell peppers
3 tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; drain and add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse water chestnuts in the colander; chop into small pieces and add to the bowl. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate; drizzle with oil and season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg tilapia fillet
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp cayenne pepper
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add tilapia to the pan; grill until golden brown and cooked through, 2-4 minutes per side.
To serve, divide arugula and tilapia between plates or bowls. Top with corn salsa, feta, and a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
